text:
emily: Starting Sparrow pilot — tiny PLG test: 80 free credits + compact prompt templates + 25-min webinar. Hypothesis: bundled onboarding increases day7 retention by ~9%. Need routing and 2 messaging variants.

ryan: Can we do Thu 10am PT for webinar? I'll prep the landing and two subject lines.

kate: Suggest split 65% credits-only, 35% credits+promptpack+webinar. Keep cohorts ~1k each if traffic allows.

leo: Ops: reserve capacity for 200 concurrent viewers, fallback to recording embed. ops-bot will auto-scale if needed.

ops-bot: autoscale rule queued. Please confirm final peak estimate by EOD.

growth-bot: Baseline: day7 retention 18.3%, avg tokens week1 2.2k, est unit cost per activation $5.90. CSV uploaded to #marketing-assets/sparrow_baseline.csv.

emily: Routing pseudo (keeps minimal):
```
segment: new_user_0-4d
trigger: first_successful_call
actions:
 - grant_credits: 80
 - attach_promptpack: sparrow-starters-v1
 - send_webinar_invite: +24h
metrics: d1_calls, prompt_use_rate, day7_retention
```

ryan: Messaging variants: A) "Ship an AI feature in 20 mins" B) "Starter templates + live demo". We'll A/B subject lines and CTA.

kate: CS follow-up: 2-email drip for webinar watchers with 3 copyable prompts and a short how-to.

emily: Action items:
- @ryan: landing + 3 subject lines + CTAs (EOD)
- @leo: reserve capacity + confirm autoscale (today)
- @kate: CS drip outline (tomorrow)
- @growth-bot: refresh baseline after seed launch

emily: Keep the seeded credit uniform to simplify analysis. We'll reconvene for a 1-week post-run check-in. :white_check_mark:
